notes.title: Continue your Slagging
notes.content:
Greetings, We hope everyone had a great new year and break!
Today we bring you the ability stop and continue your game. By this you can now stop playing after completing a level or dying, close the game completely and come back to it when you have the time to play or you are less disappointed in your slagging ability's.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193721/6b0549044a218309f4bf4dc86d0579e1e752fbd7.png[/img]
We also have introduce more data into the loadout of your tank so you now have a better idea of how different mods affect your tank. This should help you build the tank to your needs for better slagging efficiency 

High scores have been reworked as well. 
For level high score it looks at time you took to complete it.
For run high scores, it looks at how many levels you have completed then how may times you have died and finally your total time.
this will be looked at more latter as I want to add a high score viewer, I also want to add top 3 runs rather than just the best run. but this is polish and will come at the end of development. 
There also have been a tone of small fixes and tweaks such as adding an extra passive slot to the the small ball body and track body.

Most of the changes a listed below (the ones I remembered to note down) 

[list]
[*] Refactored save data
[*] Added continue functionality
[*] Refactored level high scores
[*] Refactored run high scores
[*] Refactored passive buffs system 
[*] Adjusted small Mag Ball body to have 3 passive slots (was 2)
[*] Adjusted small Track body to have 4 passive slots (was 3)
[*] Fixed compeer holding last hovered turret or body when look at mods
[*] Fixed issues where damage was not been show correctly in loadout
[*] Added more information on tank build to loadout 
[*] Fixed issue where new tec was not been show in HUD when acquired
[*] Fixed a bug where NPC's where shooting over the player, this Increased incoming  damage so reduced the spawn amounts slightly to compensate 
[/list]- 

while these changes don't look like much a lot has changed. 
Happy Slagging!

notes.title: Update 0.32
notes.content:
Greetings!
Todays update brings a number of fixes and improvements to the game. 
Here are the changes and additions.

-Fix material so laser pointer renders all the way to the cursor. (Note some weapons aim just above the cursor to give better general hit while others aim more at the ground to use AOE)
-Fix turret not adjusting height when there is no target
-Fixed smoke trail pooling early for the rockets.
-Fix empty slots not having the empty slot mod.
-Fixed loading in loadout of base build to allow for 1 nano rep and plate for free.
-Change default sizes of the cursor and its min and max possible sizes.
-Fixed color save slots losing there saved color.
-Added descriptions to all chassis and turrets.
-Changed body names to Chassis.
-All tec is exposed on start now and should be greyed out when it hasn't been unlocked.
-Added a soft warning when fitting parts when you don't have the Res for it.
-Enlarged "Res" in loadout to make it more obvious where it is also tweak colors and sizes of the res panel.
-Tweaked read sizes and added title.
-Changed "Build" button to "Launch" to try and make it more obvious.
-Fixed bug where the timer on objectives would restart if you left and re-entered they capture area.
-Added Hud bars for bosses.
-Added res gained and spent to workshop and game over screens.
-Fixed empty mod slot warning not working correctly.
-Fixed Shredder boss not chasing player.
-Fix a few gaps in the map that were causing bots and player to get stuck.

As always I am grateful for all feedback.
Happy Slagging!

notes.title: Patch 0.31
notes.content:
Just some small fixes I wanted to push to improve gameplay sooner rather than latter. 

-Aspect ratio is now locked to 16:9 due to zooming issue with wide screens.
-mouse is now captured to the screen to stop the view going wonky when you mouse off screen.
-fixed an issue where Objective bars would not be removed if you died before completing them.
-fix spelling "Moduals" to "Modules"
-fixed a few map holes and Jams in levels 4 and 5

Also as a side note if you are not seeing the normal starter mods in the loadout you may need to reset you data in "Setting".

Happy Slagging!

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
[h1][/h1]
[h2][/h2]

Greetings, 
Today we have a small patch to address a few issues and add a few things as well. We recommend that you reset your saves, To do this you can go into settings and click on the reset save data button. (this will clear all saved game progress but not graphical settings)

Change Log:
-Fixed unable to set mouse wheel to key bindings while game is running.
-LOD changes to force load some textures.
-Split turrets into NPC and Player Types for better Balancing of sheard turrets.
-Tweaked numbers on NPC turrets (should make it a bit easier).
-Added Graphic settings.
-Added auto-detect for graphic settings.
-Fix issue that no Core Tec was given when core was captured.
-Fix issue where camera would track to gantries flying over head.
-smoothed jolt that sometimes happens when aiming off platform (this needs more work).

Enjoy!

notes.title: Testing in progress
notes.content:
[h1][/h1]

Hello and welcome! 
I am very proud to say that we have now got a closed beta build of Slag up and running for testing on steam. 
If your interested in testing the game you can get in touch with me HypoConDreAct aka Luke, by either emailing me at HypoConDreAct@gmail.com or by joining our discord here https://discord.gg/c8MacNYuKJ .There are only a few slots open for testing so get in quick!
Do try to keep in mind we are based in New Zealand so our responses can be slow but we will get back to you as soon as we can. 
On to the Juice and what you can expect at this stage of development, Right now we are still in a slight Alpha state as there are a few more mechanics we would like to get up and running, so that means we do  
not have a huge amount of polish done yet.
There are bugs, some we know about and some we have know idea about, but we will squash them like these bot and if we could "Slag em" as well! 
There is and endless game loop running in this state, so you can keep running the 5 levels we have set up they get harder the deeper you go. There is a level stat and run stat system in place so you can try run them as fast as you can or as efficient as you can as all actions in Slag cost some res (apart from shooting).
there a lot of work to do but I am really hoping to push devolvement as fast as we can from here to get to a release state!
Hope to talk to you soon and that you get to have fun turning these bots to Slag!
